name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: The engineer on the Skyscraper's budget is immediately below the Robotics engineer.
The engineer on the Rover's budget is between the Structural engineer and the engineer using Copper.
The engineer using Carbon's budget is lower than both Hertz and the Structural engineer.
Hertz's budget is higher than both the engineer on the Skyscraper and the engineer using Aluminum.
The engineer using Copper's budget is exactly $20k more than Ford.
The engineer on the Reactor's budget is at least $20k away from the engineer using Carbon.
The engineer using Aluminum's budget is exactly $20k more than Diesel.
The Electrical engineer's budget is immediately below Ford.
